summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.92. Account k.erdem@aegean.edu shows a clear account-takeover pattern. The user's baseline is successful logins from 193.140.10.9 (AS-AEGEAN-EDU, Manisa, TR) on registered device dev-ke-ws during business hours across portal/mail/vpn. Interleaved with that are repeated successful logins from 203.0.113.45 (DigitalOcean, Frankfurt, DE) — a foreign cloud IP with no device_id, not via VPN, at ~02:00 local time roughly every 48 hours, accessing portal and also mail/sis, all with mfa_prompt_count=0. The anomalous geo/ASN, cloud provider, unattended device-less access, off-hours cadence, multi-app (mail/sis) reach, and absence of MFA challenge are not explained by the user's normal behavior and confirm unauthorized persistent access. Confirmed account takeover warrants immediate containment (disable session, force password reset, re-enroll MFA, review mail/sis for data access).
